text: You see Flip.

text: Arrrghhh! Die, infidel!

text: You should be in the control room. Do not tarry.

text: Never!

text: We meet again. You will not escape me this time.

text: Flip, when will I get out of here?

text: I can't wait to be together again.

text: You will not regret your decision, dearest. The dipping is painful . . .

text: Not too much, I hope.

text: The FEV is very painful, but you will live.

text: And you will join us. In body and soul.

text: We will be together again?

text: Yes, dearest. Yes.

text: I love you.

text: And I you.
